name: SA:MP (open.mp)
description: Multiplayer server for GTA San Andreas (open.mp / SA:MP 0.3.7)

steps.content:
{
  "announce": {{ANNOUNCE}},
  "artwork": {
    "cdn": "",
    "enable": {{ARTWORK_ENABLE}},
    "models_path": "models",
    "port": {{SERVER_PORT}},
    "show_crc_logs": false,
    "web_server_bind": ""
  },
  "banners": {
    "dark": "",
    "light": ""
  },
  "chat_input_filter": true,
  "discord": {
    "invite": ""
  },
  "enable_query": true,
  "game": {
    "allow_interior_weapons": true,
    "chat_radius": 200.0,
    "death_drop_amount": 0,
    "gravity": 0.00800000037997961,
    "group_player_objects": false,
    "lag_compensation_mode": 1,
    "map": "",
    "mode": "",
    "nametag_draw_radius": 70.0,
    "player_marker_draw_radius": 250.0,
    "player_marker_mode": 1,
    "time": 12,
    "use_all_animations": true,
    "use_chat_radius": false,
    "use_entry_exit_markers": true,
    "use_instagib": false,
    "use_manual_engine_and_lights": false,
    "use_nametag_los": true,
    "use_nametags": true,
    "use_player_marker_draw_radius": false,
    "use_player_ped_anims": false,
    "use_stunt_bonuses": true,
    "use_vehicle_friendly_fire": false,
    "use_zone_names": false,
    "validate_animations": true,
    "vehicle_respawn_time": 10000,
    "weather": 10
  },
  "language": "{{LANGUAGE}}",
  "logging": {
    "enable": true,
    "file": "log.txt",
    "log_chat": true,
    "log_connection_messages": true,
    "log_cookies": false,
    "log_deaths": true,
    "log_queries": false,
    "log_sqlite": false,
    "log_sqlite_queries": false,
    "timestamp_format": "[%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z]",
    "use_prefix": true,
    "use_timestamp": true
  },
  "logo": "",
  "max_bots": {{MAX_BOTS}},
  "max_players": {{MAX_PLAYERS}},
  "name": "{{SERVER_NAME}}",
  "network": {
    "acks_limit": 3000,
    "aiming_sync_rate": 30,
    "allow_037_clients": true,
    "bind": "",
    "cookie_reseed_time": 300000,
    "grace_period": 5000,
    "http_threads": 50,
    "in_vehicle_sync_rate": 30,
    "limits_ban_time": 60000,
    "message_hole_limit": 3000,
    "messages_limit": 500,
    "minimum_connection_time": 0,
    "minimum_send_bits_per_second": 96000.0,
    "mtu": 576,
    "multiplier": 10,
    "on_foot_sync_rate": 30,
    "player_marker_sync_rate": 2500,
    "player_timeout": 10000,
    "port": {{SERVER_PORT}},
    "public_addr": "",
    "stream_radius": 200.0,
    "stream_rate": 1000,
    "time_sync_rate": 30000,
    "use_lan_mode": false,
    "use_omp_encryption": false
  },
  "npc": {
    "aim_sync_skip_update_limit": 15,
    "aiming_sync_rate": 30,
    "in_vehicle_sync_rate": 30,
    "in_vehicle_sync_skip_update_limit": 15,
    "on_foot_sync_rate": 30,
    "on_foot_sync_skip_update_limit": 15,
    "process_update_rate": 50
  },
  "password": "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}",
  "pawn": {
    "legacy_plugins": [],
    "main_scripts": [
      "grandlarc 1"
    ],
    "side_scripts": []
  },
  "rcon": {
    "allow_teleport": false,
    "enable": true,
    "password": "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}"
  },
  "sleep": 5.0,
  "use_dyn_ticks": true,
  "website": "open.mp"
}

startup.command: cd Server && mkdir -p gamemodes filterscripts scriptfiles plugins components && ln -sf ../config.json scriptfiles/config.json && sed -i -e 's|\r||g' -e 's|"name": ".*"|"name": "{{SERVER_NAME}}"|' -e 's|"max_players": [0-9]*|"max_players": {{MAX_PLAYERS}}|' -e 's|"max_bots": [0-9]*|"max_bots": {{MAX_BOTS}}|' -e 's|"language": ".*"|"language": "{{LANGUAGE}}"|' -e 's|^  "password": ".*"|  "password": "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}"|' -e 's|^    "password": ".*"|    "password": "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}"|' -e '/"network": {/,/}/ s|"port": [0-9]*|"port": {{SERVER_PORT}}|' -e '/"artwork": {/,/}/ s|"enable": [a-z]*|"enable": {{ARTWORK_ENABLE}}|' -e 's|"announce": [a-z]*|"announce": {{ANNOUNCE}}|' config.json && { (sleep 3 && sed -n '/"side_scripts"/,/\]/p' config.json | grep '"' | grep -v 'side_scripts' | tr -d ' ",' | while IFS= read -r s; do [ -n "$s" ] && printf 'loadfs %s\n' "$s" && sleep 0.3; done) & while IFS= read -r l; do printf '%s\n' "$l"; [ "$l" = "exit" ] && break; done; } | exec ./omp-server {{LAUNCH_ARGS}}
